description: This file declares an interface for mapping scenarios from an ExternalMessage to Ditto Protocol messages within a Java project, including a static configuration object.

classes.name: MapToDittoProtocolScenario
classes.description: An interface defining methods for obtaining a MessageMapper and ExternalMessage, and a static configuration for mapping scenario.

methods.name: getMessageMapper
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the MessageMapper used for the mapping scenario.

methods.name: getExternalMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the ExternalMessage involved in the scenario.
